source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'San Jose Earthquakes and Apollo Announce Official Sleeve and Go-to-Market Partnership, Bringing the AI GTM System to Major League Soccer'
source.quote: announced today a multiyear Official Sleeve Partnership with Major League Soccer’s San Jose Earthquakes

note: Multiyear right-sleeve deal; logo debuted at the California Clásico on 25 July 2026. End date and value not disclosed.
